# The 144-layer matrix (docs/spec/MATRIX.md). Layer 0 is the core, which
# boots first (booklet 000, the unified alphabet, is its first booklet);
# layer N is L1 system app N, in the order of the app catalogue
# (zxv-ui/APP_CATALOG_407.csv, owned by the Built-in apps thread), with its
# icon. One line per layer, tab-separated:
# homes: paths under kernel/src whose files live in this layer ("-" for
# none yet). The longest matching path wins. A file no home names lives
# where the glue pulls it hardest (pack_matrix.py), else in the core.
# docs/ lives in layer 130, the developer documentation.
